top_signals.title: Gold Rallies as Tame US Inflation Report Calms Rate Hike Fears
top_signals.summary: Gold extended gains above $4,400 an ounce as US inflation data matched expectations, easing traders’ oncerns about imminent Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes despite elevated oil prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
